comments: Yearly returning Drake at the north end of the loch

Immature large gull, considered Caspian Gull. One photo attached, taken while the bird was swimming. It stood out from the other large gulls by its long, slim neck and very white head much cleaner than the nearby Herring Gulls, with a dark smudge around the eye and only fine mottling on the neck sides. Bill dark and straight. Grey saddle coming through against retained brown-patterned wing coverts, with clean pale underparts. In flight it appeared long and narrow-winged, with a clean white rump contrasting with a dark tail band. I'm submitting it for review as not 100% sure.
